text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Naturalistic 35mm color-film photograph of an empty old clockmaking museum gallery, walnut display counters holding mechanical clocks without legible numbers, brass pendulums, moss-green velvet and honey late-afternoon light through tall windows, authentic patina, fine film grain and subtle halation, elegant readable contrast.
